# ============================================================================
# CHAOS REDUX - AIR CLEANLINESS WINTER CONSTANTS
# ============================================================================
# Shared tuning for the deterministic state-scoped Air Winter lifecycle.
# The host integration calls one begin helper, updates each valid state once,
# and calls one finalize helper. Air Winter also owns the versioned producer
# receipt used when Fallout freezes these state values.
# ============================================================================

	terminal_winter = 6
	maximum = 6

# ============================================================================
# Shared tuning for the manually authored Air Winter event pilot. The phase
# scheduler is country-capped and runs only from the existing state update.
# ============================================================================

	schema = {
		any_key = yes
		data = fixed_point
	}

	zero = 0
	one = 1
	two = 2
	three = 3
	country_cooldown_days = 46
	delayed_short_days = 21
	delayed_standard_days = 30
	delayed_long_days = 45
	recovery_arc_cap = 3
	rail_protection_months = 4
	candidate_phase_weight = 1000
	candidate_pressure_weight = 1
	# One point above the full state-pressure range lets the island route win
	# within Phase 2 without overtaking a genuinely later phase.
	island_refugee_same_phase_bonus = 131
	# The exact desert-city subtype uses the same bounded Phase 2 interval.
	desert_city_same_phase_bonus = 131
	# The dead-city salvage route uses the same bounded score interval in Phase 5.
	dead_city_salvage_same_phase_bonus = 131
	candidate_recovery_base = 500

# After the Fallout blackout, Air Contamination is a permanent state value.
# Basis points are used by the existing contamination pipeline, so 9900 is
# displayed as ninety-nine percent. The lock is distinct from the request
# pause and from the old disabled-scenario compatibility flag.

# Fallout technology regression is applied to every live pretransition tag
# before successor allocation. Every country keeps a survival-grade infantry,
# workshop, and construction floor. Majors and special Chaos countries also
# keep the reviewed emergency support, engineering, radio, and transport floor.

		any_key = yes
		data = int

}
